# veranta-sdk

> Official TypeScript SDK for Veranta v2 perpetuals on Base (chain 8453).
> viem-based, API-first (no ABIs). Gasless trading through the Veranta
> relayer via signed EIP-712 intents; EIP-7702 smart-account relays;
> optional direct mode. React hooks at `veranta-sdk/react` (wagmi v2 +
> TanStack Query v5); AWS KMS signer at `veranta-sdk/kms` (Node only).
> Full parity with the Python veranta-sdk.

## Start here

- AGENTS.md: invariants, execution routing, signing rules, read first.
- README.md: install + backend/React quickstarts.
- examples/: runnable scripts 00-22 (22 = AWS KMS backend signer) +
  examples/next-app trading panel.

## Key facts

- `new Veranta()` reads VERANTA_PRIVATE_KEY / VERANTA_TRADER_ADDRESS /
  VERANTA_NETWORK from env; browsers pass `{ signer: walletClient }`.
- KMS backends: `const signer = await KmsSigner.create({ keyId })` from
  `veranta-sdk/kms`, then `new Veranta({ signer })` (needs the optional
  peer @aws-sdk/client-kms).
- Human units everywhere: collateral 100 = 100 USDC, leverage 10 = 10x,
  prices plain decimals. deadlines are MILLISECONDS, delegate expiry is
  SECONDS.
- Namespaces: trade, account, markets, info, referral, lp; pure math in
  the `compute` export.
- Market opens/closes/increases stream a lifecycle (MarketOrderAccepted ->
  AttemptFailed* -> MarketOrderExecuted | MarketOrderCanceled | Error).
  Error payloads carry a machine `code` (e.g. WrongSl, NO_PRICE).
- TP/SL: `trade.updateTpSl` (global, on-chain; 0 clears/resets),
  `trade.partialTpSl` CRUD (off-chain triggers with entityId).
- Session keys: react `useSessionKey()` or `account.registerDelegate`,
  delegate keys trade only, never move funds.
- Builder codes: `new Veranta({ builderCode, builderFeePercent })` (or
  VERANTA_BUILDER_CODE / VERANTA_BUILDER_FEE_PERCENT) attaches a per-order
  fee, percent of notional, to market opens/closes/increases; those orders
  relay via blitz (no SSE lifecycle), need an EIP-7702-capable signer
  (private/session key; direct mode and bare browser wallets are refused),
  and traders approve USDC to the BuilderCode registry
  (`account.approveBuilderFees`) besides TradingStorage. Owners register
  caps with `account.registerBuilderCode`; lookup `account.builderCode`.
- Base Denim (mainnet 2026-11-05 18:00 UTC): 200 ms blocks, no Flashblocks.
  Receipt polls default to 250 ms; `ExecutionConfirmedInFlashblock` is
  deprecated (never emitted); the `pending` nonce tag still works but no
  longer means preconfirmed; a position's whole-second `Trade.timestamp` can
  repeat for a close + reopen of one slot, so re-request intents bound to it
  (`closeTrade`, `closeTradeCoin`, `partialTpSl`) after any same-second change.
- Never bypass the digest assert in signing; never rename EIP-712 fields.
